summary: Lewis Robert Stacy (1787–1848) worked in history, archaeology, and Indology. He held a post at the East India Company in 1804 and served as a Lieutenant-Colonel in the Bengal Army from circa 1804 to 1848.

Lewis Sydney Stewart O'Malley (1874–1941) was a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology. He earned a B.A. from Hertford College, Oxford (~1893–1897), and served as Magistrate and Collector in the Indian Civil Service (1898–1924).

id: P:Lha Zang Lama Rigdzin Gar Gyi Wangchuk
summary: Lha Zang Lama Rigdzin Gar Gyi Wangchuk studied under Patrul Rinpoche, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso.

Tibetologist Lhagpa Phuntshogs was president of the Tibet Academy of Social Sciences (1983–1991), secretary-general of the Research Association for the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (1991–2000), and Director General of the China Tibetology Research Center starting in 2000. He founded the STTAR series.

Lhakpa Tsering specializes in Tibetology and linguistics. He has served as a Professor at Tibet University and, as attested in 2026, as Assistant Professor of Tibetan Language and Literature at the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies.

Li-Juan Su works in Buddhist studies. She earned a Master's degree at National Taiwan Normal University and has been a PhD student at National Chengchi University, where she held a PhD student post in 2024.

Li-ching Chang (1936–2010) was a sinologist and linguist. She taught Mandarin Chinese at the University of Washington, Tunghai University, Bryn Mawr College, Harvard University, the University of Pennsylvania, and Swarthmore College.
Liang Cai works in sinology, history, and archaeology. She studied under Daniel Boucher and held a post as a junior scholar at the University of Arkansas (attested 2014).
Indologist Libbie Mills earned her D.Phil. at the University of Oxford under Alexis Sanderson in 2011. Attested in 2020, she taught Sanskrit and Pali at the University of Toronto.

Lidia Wojtczak specializes in Indology and linguistics. She served as Lecturer in Sanskrit at SOAS University of London (2015–2024) and became Associate Instructional Professor in Sanskrit at the University of Chicago in 2024.
Lifei Pan specializes in Buddhist studies and sinology. He studied at Ghent University and Sichuan University, where he held a post-doctoral post in 2021.
Lili Zheng is a scholar of Buddhist studies who earned a Master of Arts at Fo Guang University under the supervision of Yongdong Shi (attested 2011).

Lilian Silburn (1908–1993) worked in Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. She studied under Paul Masson-Oursel, Louis Renou, and Swami Lakshman Joo, and held research posts at the CNRS from circa 1946 to 1978.

Lilias Homburger (1880–1969) worked in linguistics and Indology. She studied under Antoine Meillet (~1905–1914), taught at the Institut national des langues et civilisations orientales, and served as directeur d’études at the École Pratique des Hautes Études (~1934–1951).

Lilla Russell-Smith specializes in Buddhist studies, history, archaeology, and Iranian and Central Asian studies. She studied under Anna Eörsi and Pál Miklós, and earned a PhD from SOAS University of London.

Lily de Silva specialized in Indology and Buddhist studies. She studied under Julius Berugoda and M. Sri Rammandala, and held posts at the University of Ceylon (attested 1970) and the University of Peradeniya (attested 2008).

Limei Chi works in Buddhist studies and sinology and studied under Jinhua Chen. As attested in 2026, she holds posts on the faculty of the International College for Postgraduate Buddhist Studies and as Professor at the International Institute for Buddhist Studies.

Lin He (1902–1992) was a philosopher who studied at Tsinghua University (National Tsing Hua University) from circa 1919 to 1926. He subsequently held a post at National Tsing Hua University from circa 1931 to 1952.
Lin Heng specializes in Indology and Buddhist studies. She earned an MA at Silpakorn University under the supervision of Chainarong Klinnoi (attested 2015).
Lin Li is a researcher in computational linguistics who has held posts at Utrecht University and Qinghai Normal University.
